integrity: The claimed statements have analytic proofs. A five-check finite-volume program corroborates numerical implications but is not an infinite proof. Independent audit was not performed.
limitations: Coexistence inequalities are sufficient, not necessary.
Terminal divergence comes from a positive no-tumble subpopulation; the complete density's edge coefficient is not determined.
The theorem does not count all stationary-density extrema or solve the full stationary density.
Qualitative cusp and side-peak phenomena and stationary forward equations were previously reported in the motivating work.
Implicit coverage by general piecewise-deterministic stationary-density theory remains possible.
scientific_scope: Finite positive reset and flip rates; odd monotone C3 drag on a compact invariant velocity interval; stationary origin slope, critical curvature, and sufficient boundary divergence condition.
title: Exact cusp transition and boundary coexistence in nonlinear velocity resetting
